description: Search files with glob patterns and 75% token reduction through path-only results and smart filtering

absolute.description: Return absolute paths instead of paths relative to the search root

deadlineMs.description: Wall-clock budget in ms for the whole search (default 10000). On expiry the search returns what it found with metadata.searchTruncated set, instead of running until the calling tool times out.

ignore.description: Glob patterns to skip. Defaults exclude node_modules, .git, dist and build -- the last two hold real source in some projects, so metadata.ignoredMatches reports what they withheld. Pass [] to search everything.

includeContent.description: Include file content for small files

includeMetadata.description: Include file metadata (size, modified date, etc.)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

maxContentSize.description: Largest file, in bytes, for which includeContent returns content

maxSize.description: Skip files larger than this many bytes

minSize.description: Skip files smaller than this many bytes

modifiedAfter.description: Only files modified after this ISO-8601 timestamp

modifiedBefore.description: Only files modified before this ISO-8601 timestamp

offset.description: Skip this many results before returning any; use with limit to page

path.description: Directory to search. Preferred over cwd; without it the search falls back to the server process directory rather than your project.

ttl.description: Cache lifetime in seconds, when useCache is on

useCache.description: Serve a previously cached result for the same query. Off by default: the key describes the query, not the tree, so a file created between two identical searches will not appear.

name: smart_glob
